response.body: The proving zero energy before intrusive work must be provided, and its effectiveness must be recorded as a assurance activity before the task proceeds. The re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation must be set at 24 hours. This clause applies to activities archived under ELECTRICAL-SAFETY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
